title: Technology UI: Bio-Stims and Focused Research
description: Two technology-dialog changes. Bio-Stims: a strip in the technology dialog shows the card's state (usable at the end of the turn, ready with nothing to ready, exhausted) and what it could ready now (exhausted specialty planets, exhausted technologies); it mirrors the engine's end-of-turn offer. Focused Research: from rules version 18 the card spends its 4 trade goods and asks the Technology primary's research_technology question, so the normal technology dialog opens (engine-legal list, prerequisites, skips, resources) instead of a plain option list. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server; the before shots are the pre-18 question shape (bare technology pick).

notes.title: Reading of the bug list
notes.text: Bio-Stims is an end-of-turn card. The engine already offers it (technology.rs end_turn: exhausted specialty planets and exhausted other technologies) but the technology dialog never showed it. The strip is display only; the offer itself is unchanged. Focused Research is the action card f_researched (spend 4 trade goods to research 1 technology).
